{{Quote|I only deal in rare contraband, it appears you do not have any. We have no business at this time.|Russell, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SC" />}}
'''Russell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a leader in the criminal underworld during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Russell operated out of the [[Trade Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] as an illicit broker, serving as a point of contact for aspiring [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Smugglers who had sufficiently advanced in the criminal underworld were entrusted by Russell with delivering contraband items to customers.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Russell was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Russell was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Smuggler#Underworld Smuggler Missions|smuggling missions]] introduced with the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|"Chapter 3" update]], released on [[September 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter Archive 2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref>
